title: Russia is ‘setting traps’ in Ukraine talks, EU foreign policy chief warns
summary_full: Kaja Kallas says Moscow is trying to divert attention from its aggression by raising issue of European securityEurope live – latest updatesThe EU’s foreign policy chief has warned against “walking into the traps that Russia is setting” as she said Moscow was trying to start a debate about European security in order to divert attention from its aggression.“We have one aggressor and one victim, and the aggressor does not have security concerns,” Kaja Kallas said on arrival at an EU leaders’ summit in Dublin. “Nobody has ever attacked them. They have attacked others. I mean, keep the focus, people.” Continue reading...
